notToBeConfusedWith.name: Cranberry juice, unsweetened
notToBeConfusedWith.note: This record is the sweetened cocktail blend sold as 'cranberry juice' in bars; the unsweetened 100% juice is far more tart and is a different bottle.

forms.label: Bottled, sweetened
forms.sourceNote: Cranberry juice cocktail, bottled. Public domain. This is the sweetened cocktail blend a bar pours, not unsweetened cranberry juice, which USDA carries as a separate, far more tart record. acidPercent is left off: USDA does not report titratable acidity and no measured figure was found for this blend.
